title: OpenEPCIS Iron & Steel Vocabulary
description:
Vocabulary for the iron & steel ESPR priority product group
(Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 Annex I; iron & steel named in Article 5 / the 2025-2030
working plan). Covers steel-specific identification (heat / cast / lot numbers,
grade classification per EN 10020 and designation per EN 10027), production route,
and the Material Test Certificate (EN 10204 inspection documents with EN 10168
mechanical and chemical parameters).

This module is intentionally thin per the project's four-layer delegation pattern.
Steel-specific concepts live here; cross-cutting concerns (recycled content,
substances of concern, environmental product declaration, carbon footprint,
documents) reuse the lifted `oec:` vocabulary plus `untp:` and `gs1:`.

Aligned with the DPP Keystone iron & steel profile (dppk:IronSteelProduct /
dppk:MaterialTestCertificate).

classes.label: Iron & Steel Product
classes.comment:
An iron or steel product (e.g. rebar, structural section, plate, coil,
wire rod) subject to the ESPR iron & steel delegated act. Carrier for steel
identification, grade/designation, production route, and the Material Test
Certificate. Reuse oec: terms for recycled content, substances of concern,
environmental product declaration, and supporting documents.

classes.label: Material Test Certificate
classes.comment:
An inspection document for metallic products per EN 10204 (type 2.1, 2.2,
3.1, or 3.2), carrying the EN 10168 mechanical and chemical test parameters that
substantiate the declared grade. An oea:Assessment: each mechanical, chemical or radiometric value is an
oea:MeasurementResult (oea:hasResult) observing one of the eusteel: performance parameters below,
with its UN/CEFACT unit (MPA, P1, C62); document type, process, finishing, nominal size and weight
tolerance describe the certificate and stay as its own properties.

properties.label: Cast Number
properties.comment: Cast number identifying the casting run within a heat (EN 10168 traceability).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Cast numbers are EN 10168 batch-traceability identifiers of the professional delivery record.

properties.label: CBAM Report ID
properties.comment: Identifier of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism report associated with the steel product.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The CBAM report identifier keys into embedded-emissions filings that Reg. (EU) 2023/956 (Arts. 6, 35) exchanges only between operators, authorised declarants and authorities, so it stays with the authority/declarant tier.

properties.label: Material Test Certificate
properties.comment: Links a steel product to its Material Test Certificate (EN 10204).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The EN 10204 certificate is a B2B inspection document issued to the purchaser, professional detail rather than consumer information.

properties.label: Technology Route
properties.comment: Primary steelmaking route used to produce the product.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The steelmaking route (e.g. BF-BOF vs EAF) is the headline green-steel differentiator buyers and consumers rely on, without exposing installation-level emissions data.

properties.label: Heat Number
properties.comment: Heat (melt) number identifying the batch of molten steel from which the product was cast (EN 10168 traceability).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Heat numbers are EN 10168 batch-traceability identifiers linking deliveries to production runs, supply-chain data for professional actors.

properties.label: Lot Number
properties.comment: Delivery lot number for the steel product.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Delivery lot numbers tie the product to specific commercial shipments, supply-chain data for professional actors.

properties.label: Melt and Pour Country
properties.comment: Country where the steel was melted and poured (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Relevant to origin and CBAM reporting.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Country of melt and pour is an origin-transparency claim at country granularity, exposing no facility or supplier detail.

properties.label: MTC Finishing
properties.comment: Finishing / delivery condition recorded on the certificate (e.g. hot-rolled, normalised, quenched and tempered).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The delivery/finishing condition is certificate content agreed between producer and purchaser.

properties.label: MTC Inspection Document Type
properties.accessLevelRationale: The EN 10204 document type (2.1-3.2) is certificate metadata belonging to the professional MTC record.

properties.label: MTC Nominal Size
properties.comment: Nominal dimension of the tested product (mm).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The tested nominal dimension is certificate content of the B2B inspection document.

properties.label: MTC Steel Process
properties.comment: Steelmaking process recorded on the certificate (free text where the controlled eusteel:TechnologyRoute is not used).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The free-text process entry on the certificate is production detail for the purchaser; the public claim is the controlled technologyRoute.

properties.label: MTC Weight Tolerance
properties.comment: Permitted weight tolerance of the tested product (%).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The permitted weight tolerance is contractual certificate content between producer and purchaser.

properties.label: Product Number
properties.comment: Manufacturer product / article number for the steel product.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The manufacturer article number is ordinary public product identity, stamped or tagged on the product.

properties.label: Purchaser Order
properties.comment: Purchaser order reference associated with the steel delivery.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The purchaser order reference exposes a specific commercial relationship and belongs to the B2B delivery record.

properties.label: Steel Designation
properties.comment: Steel name / number designation per EN 10027 (e.g. S355J2 / 1.0577).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The EN 10027 steel designation is standardised public product identity every buyer specifies against.

properties.label: Steel Grade Classification
properties.comment: Classification of the steel grade per EN 10020 (unalloyed, stainless, other alloy).
properties.accessLevelRationale: The EN 10020 grade classification is a coarse public typing of the material with no commercial sensitivity.

values.label: Carbon Content
values.comment: Carbon content from the cast/ladle analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcCarbonContent.

values.label: Carbon Equivalent
values.comment: Carbon equivalent value (CEV or CET), the weldability figure derived from the cast analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcCarbonEquivalent.

values.label: Copper Content
values.comment: Copper content from the cast analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcCopperContent.

values.label: Elongation
values.comment: Percentage elongation after fracture (A, or Agt for reinforcing steel); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcElongation.

values.label: Nitrogen Content
values.comment: Nitrogen content from the cast analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcNitrogenContent.

values.label: Phosphorus Content
values.comment: Phosphorus content from the cast analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcPhosphorusContent.

values.label: Radiometric Control
values.comment: Radiometric (radioactivity) control result for the steel, in the unit the certificate states; unitCode C62. Replaces eusteel:mtcRadiometricControl.

values.label: Relative Rib Area
values.comment: Relative rib area fR of ribbed reinforcing steel (bond performance); unitCode C62. Replaces eusteel:mtcRelativeRibArea.

values.label: Sulfur Content
values.comment: Sulfur content from the cast analysis (mass %); unitCode P1. Replaces eusteel:mtcSulfurContent.

values.label: Tensile Strength
values.comment: Ultimate tensile strength Rm from the tensile test; unitCode MPA. Replaces eusteel:mtcTensileStrength.

values.label: Yield Strength
values.comment: Yield strength Re from the tensile test; unitCode MPA. Replaces eusteel:mtcYieldStrength.

values.label: Yield Strength Ratio
values.comment: Ratio of tensile strength to yield strength Rm/Re, the k value of reinforcing steel (EN 10080; the replaced eusteel:mtcYieldStrengthRatio said Re/Rm, while the examples carried Rm/Re); unitCode C62. Replaces eusteel:mtcYieldStrengthRatio.

enumerations.label: Steel Production Technology Route
enumerations.comment: Primary steelmaking route, a key driver of embodied carbon.
